findings.title: Cached *dtos.EntryPointAssets is shared unsafely across callers
findings.body: The mutex only protects the cache pointer itself. GetWebAssets returns the same *dtos.EntryPointAssets instance to every caller, and in Dev mode a new instance is built (including a call to SetContentDeliveryURL on line 64) while other goroutines may still be reading the previously returned instance. If any caller ever mutates the returned DTO (or if Dev-mode rebuilds race with concurrent readers of the old value in ways that touch shared inner slices), the race persists. At minimum the code relies on the undocumented assumption that EntryPointAssets is never mutated after being returned; consider documenting that contract or returning a copy.

findings.title: CDN read error is silently discarded when file fallback succeeds
findings.body: When cdn is non-empty and readWebAssetsFromCDN fails (line 56), err holds the CDN error, but line 60 overwrites err with the result of the file read. If the file read then succeeds, the CDN failure is completely lost with no log or trace, making it impossible to diagnose why assets are being served from disk instead of the CDN. The error should be logged or wrapped before falling back.

findings.title: No test covers the race being fixed
findings.body: The PR's stated purpose is fixing a data race on entryPointAssetsCache, but no test is added. Running the existing code under `go test -race` with concurrent GetWebAssets calls (Dev and non-Dev) should be added to prevent regression; otherwise the lock could be removed again without detection.
